blocks.text: Red Road Recovery is an addictions treatment centre for substance abuse and concurrent disorders located in Sorrento BC. Our rehabilitation program focuses on healing the mind, body and spirit through the bio/pyscho-social model, integrated with traditional indigenous healing practices and recovery through the 12 Steps. We believe everyone is different with their own underlying issues and needs, hence why we believe in building individualized treatment plans structured to address each client specifically. We have two other locations currently: Red Road Ranch in Lumby and Red Road Recovery in Sorrento BC.

blocks.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
